2609.21246.title: VLA-Scope: Shift-Aware Failure Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models
2609.21246.paper_summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and natural-language instructions to robotic actions, but distribution shifts can compromise their reliability. Because these models may still succeed under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, detecting OOD inputs alone is insufficient to predict execution failure. In this paper, we introduce VLA-Scope, a two-stage framework that combines input-shift characterization with execution history to predict failure during OOD rollouts. The first stage uses pooled image and language representations to detect OOD inputs and classify their shift categories. For inputs flagged as OOD, the second stage combines the predicted category, action-prefix features, and execution progress features. A logistic regression model shared across shift categories updates failure risk as execution proceeds. We evaluate the framework with OpenVLA on ten LIBERO-Spatial tasks using leave-one-group-out cross-validation. OOD detection achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.9454, and shift classification achieves 91% accuracy. Evaluated independently of the OOD gate on all 1,400 OOD rollouts, the failure predictor achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.8497 after 60 executed actions, compared with 0.7906 without execution progress features. It also achieves a higher ROC-AUC than the evaluated ActProbe and SAFE-MLP baselines. These results suggest that combining action features with temporally aggregated execution step representations improves failure prediction under input shifts.
2609.21246.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動 (VLA) 模型將視覺觀察和自然語言指令映射到機器人行動，但分佈變化可能會妨礙它們的可靠性。因為這些模型在分佈外 (OOD) 條件下仍可能成功，僅僅檢測 OOD 輸入不足以預測執行失敗。在本文中，我們介紹了 VLA-Scope，一個兩階段框架，將輸入變化特徵與執行歷史結合，以預測 OOD 展開期間的失敗。第一階段使用聚合的圖像和語言表示來檢測 OOD 輸入並分類其變化類別。對於被標記為 OOD 的輸入，第二階段結合預測的類別、行動前綴特徵和執行進度特徵。共享於變化類別的邏輯回歸模型隨著執行的進行更新失敗風險。我們使用 OpenVLA 在十個 LIBERO-Spatial 任務上進行了框架評估，採用留一組交叉驗證。OOD 檢測達到 0.9454 的 ROC-AUC，而變化分類達到 91% 的準確率。在所有 1,400 次 OOD 展開中，獨立於 OOD 閘進行評估的失敗預測器在執行 60 次行動後達到 0.8497 的 ROC-AUC，而沒有執行進度特徵則為 0.7906。它的 ROC-AUC 也高於評估的 ActProbe 和 SAFE-MLP 基準。這些結果表明，將行動特徵與時間聚合的執行步驟表示結合可以改善在輸入變化下的失敗預測。
